decisions.reason: Although the online customer portal is distant from the firm's core display offer and only lightly publicized, it is newly launched, supports closer customer collaboration and information-security ambitions, and management is likely to give it more time rather than quickly admit a mistaken investment.
This packaging display solution fits the core business, was publicly presented, and its 2024 packaging award gives management strong justification to continue and build on the commitment.

The quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display is close to the established offer and has its own webpage, so the firm has visibly committed to it and is likely to retain it unless clear failure emerges.

The small cardboard counter display is a straightforward extension of the firm's established display range, and the public listing on its own page makes management more inclined to continue rather than reverse course after only one year.

The large freestanding cardboard information display closely matches the firm's capabilities and strategic direction toward broader 3D cardboard solutions, so management is likely to keep backing it despite limited early evidence.
